title: Canonical evidence and governed apply for generated artifacts

phases.objective: Publish one bounded read-only canonical report for PR generated-artifact evaluation and preserve mutation behind a registered manually dispatched exact-head tool.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: PR Generated Artifact Refresh on an internal governed pull request after the trusted workflow definition is present on the default branch
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The pull-request workflow reports exact-head pass, drift, or first failure without repository mutation, and the trusted workflow_run publisher updates the authoritative PR comment without Job-log reconstruction.
steps: Treat the workflow definition on the default branch as the active pull-request automation authority until this change is merged.
Checkout the exact source PR head with read-only contents permission and without persisted credentials.
Generate and verify the bounded artifact set only inside the ephemeral runner workspace.
Return generated_artifact_drift_detected when reviewed generated files differ.
Upload canonical JSON and Markdown before enforcing the decision.
Validate the report against the current exact PR head before updating the authoritative comment.
assertions: candidate_sha and source_head_sha equal the exact pull-request head.
The PR workflow contains no repository write permission, git push, or persisted checkout credentials.
The report declares secrets_included=false and bounded redacted diagnostics.
The publisher rejects stale, substituted, mismatched, closed-unmerged, or ambiguous PR identities.
The tests remain discoverable through the canonical repository test manifest.
Pre-merge behavior of a pull_request workflow is not used as proof of its replacement definition; operational proof begins after the trusted definition reaches the default branch.
Job logs remain diagnostic-only and never override the canonical report.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A registered tool mutates only reviewed generated paths on a non-protected work branch after exact-head and typed-confirmation checks, and emits a canonical report before enforcement.
steps: Require target_ref, expected_head_sha, and APPLY_GENERATED_ARTIFACT_REFRESH confirmation.
Reject main, Production, invalid branch names, and malformed SHAs before generation.
Compare both local and remote heads to expected_head_sha before commit and again before push.
Generate and verify the bounded artifact set.
Reject every path outside the registered allowlist.
Commit and push by normal fast-forward only, then upload JSON and Markdown evidence.
assertions: The tool is registered as mutating under the governed maintenance-tool root.
The workflow is workflow_dispatch-only and not pull_request-triggered.
Protected branches are rejected and force push is absent.
Concurrent target-ref movement returns an expected-head mismatch without writing.
The report contract is mad4b.governed-generated-artifact-refresh.v1 with secrets_included=false.

phases.objective: Add trusted PR-comment routing for manually dispatched maintenance-tool reports where an exact PR association is supplied.
Exercise artifact-download failure, stale-head races, malformed reports, publisher retries, and generated write-set violations without consulting Job logs for the decision.
Observe canonical read-only evaluation and governed apply reports on representative generated-artifact PRs after the workflow definition reaches the default branch.
Require exact generated-artifact canonical evidence for protected-branch merge readiness while retaining manual governed mutation only on work branches.
